problem: A later interrupted owner could not retire while a retained, retired BrassRing or Njoyn plan still had an interrupted monitor receipt. Their existing browser profiles were missing from the historical ownership allowlist.
change: Recognize these two existing profiles only when the older retired immutable plan owned the same monitor board. Keep the existing epoch, task identity, plan state and foreign-fence checks.

regression.before: Both fail when the current interrupted owner retires with legitimate retained history.
regression.after: Both pass against migrated isolated PostgreSQL and real Redis with the race detector.

limits: This candidate does not migrate another publisher, establish production freshness or change deployed ownership. Include it with the next grouped monitor batch; required CI and supported deployment remain outstanding.
